title: Gentle Words, Ardent Spirit: Li Qingzhao's Poetry
synopsis: Li Qingzhao was a groundbreaking female poet of the Song dynasty, known for her works of "delicate restraint". Her gentle writing style concealed an ardent spirit, which helped her forge her way in a male-dominated society.

fullText.simplified:
《如梦令》——柔词烈骨李清照

    “知否，知否，应是绿肥红瘦”，这是几乎每个中国人都耳熟能详的一句宋词，出自宋代女词人李清照的名作——《如梦令》。
    《如梦令》是词牌名，宋词每个词牌都有固定的字数和韵律要求，作者根据自己想表达的内容填词。李清照的《如梦令》是婉约派的代表作之一，共33字，李清照这样填写：
    昨夜雨疏风骤，浓睡不消残酒。试问卷帘人，却道海棠依旧。知否，知否，应是绿肥红瘦。
    “雨疏风骤”形容昨夜小雨零星，大风猛烈；“浓睡”是深沉的睡眠。“昨夜雨疏风骤，浓睡不消残酒”给出了环境描写：昨夜一场猛烈的大风带着零星的小雨，作者即使睡得很沉，醒来后仍然觉得有些醉意没有完全散去。
    “试问卷帘人，却道海棠依旧”讲的是：作者问正在卷起窗帘的侍女：“院子里的花怎么样了？”侍女回答说：“海棠花还是和昨天一样。”作者关心院子里的花是否被风吹落，但侍女的回答却让她感到有些失落。
    “应是绿肥红瘦”里“应”是应该、可能的意思，“肥”形容绿叶茂盛，“瘦”描写了大风过后海棠红花凋零的景象。“知否，知否，应是绿肥红瘦”是作者内心的想法：你知道吗？你知道吗？真正的情况应该是——绿色的叶子更加茂盛，而红色的花瓣却已经凋零变少了。这句话表达了作者对美好事物流逝的感慨，也透露出一丝淡淡的忧愁。
    整首词描写了夜雨后的海棠花落。李清照用“绿肥红瘦”这个词非常形象地表达了“春天将尽、花朵凋零”的景象。整首词情感细腻，让人感觉非常温柔。因此，这首词是婉约词的代表作之一。但当我们走近作者时，却感觉反差强烈。
    李清照出生在山东济南，父母生活富裕又有文化，因此她从小就看遍了文学经典，年轻时写下了这首《如梦令》，震动当时文坛，被称为“千古第一才女”。然而，这位才女的独立精神远超当时社会的想象。新婚时，她与丈夫典当衣物来收集文物，将前半生都奉献给了文化艺术。中年时，北宋灭亡，丈夫去世，她收藏的文物大部分都在战争中丢失了。因为没有子女，为了保护剩余的文物，她再次结婚，却发现第二任丈夫只想利用这些文物换取官职。李清照将丈夫告上法庭，要求离婚。当时妻子起诉丈夫可能要坐牢，但即便如此，李清照仍然这么做了。
    李清照的前半生因为生活幸福，写尽了温柔之词；后半生历经变故，诗词风格越来越沉郁，但她的灵魂始终坚定不屈。可以说她的一生是用最温柔的语言包裹最坚强的灵魂。在男性主导的宋代，她以“柔词烈骨”的创作风格，为女性争取了更多的话语权。
fullText.traditional:
《如夢令》——柔詞烈骨李清照

    “知否，知否，應是綠肥紅瘦”，這是幾乎每個中國人都耳熟能詳的一句宋詞，出自宋代女詞人李清照的名作——《如夢令》。
    《如夢令》是詞牌名，宋詞每個詞牌都有固定的字數和韻律要求，作者根據自己想表達的內容填詞。李清照的《如夢令》是婉約派的代表作之一，共33字，李清照這樣填寫：
    昨夜雨疏風驟，濃睡不消殘酒。試問卷簾人，卻道海棠依舊。知否，知否，應是綠肥紅瘦。
    “雨疏風驟”形容昨夜小雨零星，大風猛烈；“濃睡”是深沉的睡眠。“昨夜雨疏風驟，濃睡不消殘酒”給出了環境描寫：昨夜一場猛烈的大風帶著零星的小雨，作者即使睡得很沉，醒來後仍然覺得有些醉意沒有完全散去。
    “試問卷簾人，卻道海棠依舊”講的是：作者問正在卷起窗簾的侍女：“院子裡的花怎麼樣了？”侍女回答說：“海棠花還是和昨天一樣。”作者關心院子裡的花是否被風吹落，但侍女的回答卻讓她感到有些失落。
    “應是綠肥紅瘦”裡“應”是應該、可能的意思，“肥”形容綠葉茂盛，“瘦”描寫了大風過後海棠紅花凋零的景象。“知否，知否，應是綠肥紅瘦”是作者內心的想法：你知道嗎？你知道嗎？真正的情況應該是——綠色的葉子更加茂盛，而紅色的花瓣卻已經凋零變少了。這句話表達了作者對美好事物流逝的感慨，也透露出一絲淡淡的憂愁。
    整首詞描寫了夜雨後的海棠花落。李清照用“綠肥紅瘦”這個詞非常形象地表達了“春天將盡、花朵凋零”的景象。整首詞情感細膩，讓人感覺非常溫柔。因此，這首詞是婉約詞的代表作之一。但當我們走近作者時，卻感覺反差強烈。
    李清照出生在山東濟南，父母生活富裕又有文化，因此她從小就看遍了文學經典，年輕時寫下了這首《如夢令》，震動當時文壇，被稱為“千古第一才女”。然而，這位才女的獨立精神遠超當時社會的想像。新婚時，她與丈夫典當衣物來收集文物，將前半生都奉獻給了文化藝術。中年時，北宋滅亡，丈夫去世，她收藏的文物大部分都在戰爭中丟失了。因為沒有子女，為了保護剩餘的文物，她再次結婚，卻發現第二任丈夫只想利用這些文物換取官職。李清照將丈夫告上法庭，要求離婚。當時妻子起訴丈夫可能要坐牢，但即便如此，李清照仍然這麼做了。
    李清照的前半生因為生活幸福，寫盡了溫柔之詞；後半生歷經變故，詩詞風格越來越沈鬱，但她的靈魂始終堅定不屈。可以說她的一生是用最溫柔的語言包裹最堅強的靈魂。在男性主導的宋代，她以“柔詞烈骨”的創作風格，為女性爭取了更多的話語權。

sentences.traditional: 李清照出生在山東濟南，父母生活富裕又有文化，因此她從小就看遍了文學經典，
sentences.pinyin: lǐ qīng zhào chū shēng zài shān dōng jǐ nán fù mǔ shēng huó fù yù yòu yǒu wén huà yīn cǐ tā cóng xiǎo jiù kàn biàn le wén xué jīng diǎn

sentences.simplified: 年轻时写下了这首《如梦令》，
sentences.traditional: 年輕時寫下了這首《如夢令》，
sentences.pinyin: nián qīng shí xiě xià le zhè shǒu rú mèng lìng
sentences.english: Li Qingzhao was born in Jinan, Shandong. Her parents were affluent and cultured, so she had read all the literary classics at a young age.

sentences.simplified: 震动当时文坛，被称为“千古第一才女”。
sentences.traditional: 震動當時文壇，被稱為“千古第一才女”。
sentences.pinyin: zhèn dòng dāng shí wén tán bèi chēng wéi qiān gǔ dì yī cái nǚ
sentences.english: In her youth, she wrote this ci lyric to the tune “As If in a Dream”.

sentences.simplified: 然而，这位才女的独立精神远超当时社会的想象。
sentences.traditional: 然而，這位才女的獨立精神遠超當時社會的想像。
sentences.pinyin: rán ér zhè wèi cái nǚ de dú lì jīng shén yuǎn chāo dāng shí shè huì de xiǎng xiàng
sentences.english: It shook the literary world of the time and earned her the title of “the greatest female talent of the ages”.

sentences.simplified: 新婚时，她与丈夫典当衣物来收集文物，
sentences.traditional: 新婚時，她與丈夫典當衣物來收集文物，
sentences.pinyin: xīn hūn shí tā yǔ zhàng fu diǎn dàng yī wù lái shōu jí wén wù
sentences.english: However, this talented woman’s independent spirit far exceeded the imagination of society at that time.

sentences.simplified: 将前半生都奉献给了文化艺术。
sentences.traditional: 將前半生都奉獻給了文化藝術。
sentences.pinyin: jiāng qián bàn shēng dōu fèng xiàn gěi le wén huà yì shù
sentences.english: When newly married, she and her husband pawned their clothes to collect cultural relics.

sentences.simplified: 中年时，北宋灭亡，丈夫去世，她收藏的文物大部分都在战争中丢失了。
sentences.traditional: 中年時，北宋滅亡，丈夫去世，她收藏的文物大部分都在戰爭中丟失了。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng nián shí běi sòng miè wáng zhàng fu qù shì tā shōu cáng de wén wù dà bù fen dōu zài zhàn zhēng zhōng diū shī le
sentences.english: She dedicated the first half of her life to culture and art.

sentences.simplified: 因为没有子女，为了保护剩余的文物，她再次结婚，
sentences.traditional: 因為沒有子女，為了保護剩餘的文物，她再次結婚，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi méi yǒu zǐ nǚ wèi le bǎo hù shèng yú de wén wù tā zài cì jié hūn
sentences.english: In her middle age, the Northern Song Dynasty fell, and her husband passed away. Most of the relics she had collected were lost in the war.

sentences.simplified: 却发现第二任丈夫只想利用这些文物换取官职。
sentences.traditional: 卻發現第二任丈夫只想利用這些文物換取官職。
sentences.pinyin: què fā xiàn dì èr rèn zhàng fu zhǐ xiǎng lì yòng zhè xiē wén wù huàn qǔ guān zhí
sentences.english: Because she had no children, she remarried in order to protect the remaining relics.

sentences.simplified: 李清照将丈夫告上法庭，要求离婚。
sentences.traditional: 李清照將丈夫告上法庭，要求離婚。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ qīng zhào jiāng zhàng fu gào shàng fǎ tíng yāo qiú lí hūn
sentences.english: However, she discovered that her second husband only wanted to use these relics to gain an official position.

sentences.simplified: 当时妻子起诉丈夫可能要坐牢，但即便如此，李清照仍然这么做了。
sentences.traditional: 當時妻子起訴丈夫可能要坐牢，但即便如此，李清照仍然這麼做了。
sentences.pinyin: dāng shí qī zi qǐ sù zhàng fu kě néng yào zuò láo dàn jí biàn rú cǐ lǐ qīng zhào réng rán zhè me zuò le
sentences.english: Li Qingzhao took her husband to court, seeking a divorce.
At that time, a wife suing her husband could potentially face imprisonment, yet Li Qingzhao still chose to do so.

sentences.simplified: 李清照的前半生因为生活幸福，写尽了温柔之词；
sentences.traditional: 李清照的前半生因為生活幸福，寫盡了溫柔之詞；
sentences.pinyin: lǐ qīng zhào de qián bàn shēng yīn wèi shēng huó xìng fú xiě jìn le wēn róu zhī cí

sentences.simplified: 后半生历经变故，诗词风格越来越沉郁，
sentences.traditional: 後半生歷經變故，詩詞風格越來越沈鬱，
sentences.pinyin: hòu bàn shēng lì jīng biàn gù shī cí fēng gé yuè lái yuè chēn yù
sentences.english: In the first half of her life, Li Qingzhao wrote tender verses due to her happy life.

sentences.simplified: 但她的灵魂始终坚定不屈。
sentences.traditional: 但她的靈魂始終堅定不屈。
sentences.pinyin: dàn tā de líng hún shǐ zhōng jiān dìng bù qū
sentences.english: In the second half of her life, after experiencing upheavals, her poetry style became increasingly melancholic.

sentences.simplified: 可以说她的一生是用最温柔的语言包裹最坚强的灵魂。
sentences.traditional: 可以說她的一生是用最溫柔的語言包裹最堅強的靈魂。
sentences.pinyin: kě yǐ shuō tā de yì shēng shì yòng zuì wēn róu de yǔ yán bāo guǒ zuì jiān qiáng de líng hún
sentences.english: Despite this, her spirit remained steadfast and unyielding.

sentences.simplified: 在男性主导的宋代，她以“柔词烈骨”的创作风格，为女性争取了更多的话语权。
sentences.traditional: 在男性主導的宋代，她以“柔詞烈骨”的創作風格，為女性爭取了更多的話語權。
sentences.pinyin: zài nán xìng zhǔ dǎo de sòng dài tā yǐ róu cí liè gǔ de chuàng zuò fēng gé wèi nǚ xìng zhēng qǔ le gèng duō de huà yǔ quán
sentences.english: One could say that in her life, she wrapped the strongest of souls in the gentlest of words.

sentence_translations: “As If in a Dream”: Li Qingzhao’s Gentle Words and Ardent Spirit
“Don’t you know? Don’t you know? The greens should be plump; the reds bare.”
This is a line from a Song Dynasty ci lyric that almost every Chinese person can recite.
It comes from a famous work by the Song Dynasty female ci lyricist Li Qingzhao, “As If in a Dream”.
“As If in a Dream” is the name of a tune pattern used in ci lyrics.
Each tune pattern used in Song Dynasty ci lyrics has fixed requirements for the number of characters and rhyme scheme.
Authors then compose lyrics based on the content they wish to express.
Li Qingzhao’s ci lyric to the tune “As If in a Dream” is one of the representative works of the “delicate restraint school”.
It has a total of 33 characters. Li Qingzhao composed the lyrics like this:
Last night, scattered rain and sudden wind; a deep sleep could not dispel what remained of the wine.
I tried asking the maid who raised the blinds, but she said the crabapple was as before.
Don’t you know? Don’t you know? The greens should be plump; the reds bare.
“雨疏风骤” describes the scattered light rain and strong winds of the night before.
“浓睡” refers to a deep sleep.
“昨夜雨疏风骤，浓睡不消残酒” provides a description of the environment: A strong wind accompanied by scattered rain.
Even though the author slept deeply, upon waking, she felt that her tipsiness had not completely dissipated.
“试问卷帘人，却道海棠依旧” is saying: The author asks the maid who is raising the blinds, “How are the flowers in the courtyard?”
The maid replies, “The crabapple flowers are still the same as yesterday.”
The author was concerned about whether the flowers in the courtyard had been blown off by the wind, ..
.. but the maid’s response left her feeling somewhat disappointed.
In “应是绿肥红瘦”, “应” means “should” or “possibly”, ..
.. “肥” describes the lush green leaves, and “瘦” depicts the bare look of the crabapple tree after the gale has passed.
“知否，知否，应是绿肥红瘦” are the author’s inner thoughts: Don’t you know? Don’t you know?
The true situation should be that the green leaves are more lush, while the red petals have withered and become fewer.
This line expresses the author’s lament for the passing of beautiful things and also reveals a hint of subtle melancholy.
The ci lyric as a whole describes the falling of crabapple flowers after a night of rain.
Li Qingzhao uses the phrase “绿肥红瘦” to vividly express the image of “the end of spring and the withering of flowers”.
The ci lyric as a whole is emotionally delicate, giving one a very gentle feeling.
Therefore, this ci lyric is one of the representative works of the “delicate restraint” style of ci.
However, when we get closer to the author, we feel a strong contrast.
Li Qingzhao was born in Jinan, Shandong. Her parents were affluent and cultured, so she had read all the literary classics at a young age.
In her youth, she wrote this ci lyric to the tune “As If in a Dream”.
It shook the literary world of the time and earned her the title of “the greatest female talent of the ages”.
However, this talented woman’s independent spirit far exceeded the imagination of society at that time.
When newly married, she and her husband pawned their clothes to collect cultural relics.
She dedicated the first half of her life to culture and art.
In her middle age, the Northern Song Dynasty fell, and her husband passed away. Most of the relics she had collected were lost in the war.
Because she had no children, she remarried in order to protect the remaining relics.
However, she discovered that her second husband only wanted to use these relics to gain an official position.
Li Qingzhao took her husband to court, seeking a divorce.
At that time, a wife suing her husband could potentially face imprisonment, yet Li Qingzhao still chose to do so.
In the first half of her life, Li Qingzhao wrote tender verses due to her happy life.
In the second half of her life, after experiencing upheavals, her poetry style became increasingly melancholic.
Despite this, her spirit remained steadfast and unyielding.
One could say that in her life, she wrapped the strongest of souls in the gentlest of words.
In the male-dominated Song Dynasty, she advocated for a greater voice for women with her creative style of “gentle words and ardent spirit”.
